material.mattext: Which of the following symbols represents "and" in propositional logic?
∨
∧
→
¬
If M = "It will rain on Monday" and T = "It will rain on Tuesday", which symbolization represents "It will rain on Monday and it will rain on Tuesday"?
M ∨ T
M ∧ T
M → T
If P = "The package arrived" and Q = "The package was damaged", which symbolization represents "The package arrived, but it was not damaged"?
P ∧ Q

Consider the sentence "It will rain on Monday and it will rain on Tuesday or it will rain on Wednesday" with M, T, W as obvious sentence letters. Which of the following is NOT a possible symbolization of this sentence?
(M ∧ T) ∨ W
M ∧ (T ∨ W)
M ∨ (T ∧ W)
In the sentence (P ∧ Q) ∨ R, which is the main connective?
∧
∨
There is no main connective
In the sentence P → (Q ∧ (R ∨ ¬S)) what is the main connective?
∧
∨
→
¬
